COMBATE.Economia.foraDoTurno: It is not this character's turn.
COMBATE.Barra.vazio: Nothing here to use in combat.
COMBATE.Basica.disparada.chat: dashes, gaining extra movement this turn.
COMBATE.Basica.esquiva.dica: Attacks against you have disadvantage until the start of your next turn.
COMBATE.Basica.esquiva.chat: takes a defensive stance and dodges.
COMBATE.Basica.desengajar.dica: Your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks this turn.
COMBATE.Basica.desengajar.chat: disengages carefully; no opportunity attacks this turn.
COMBATE.Basica.ajudar.dica: Gives an ally advantage on their next check or attack. Target them first.
COMBATE.Basica.preparar.dica: Readies an action for a trigger (uses your Reaction when it fires).
COMBATE.Basica.preparar.chat: readies an action and waits for the right moment.
COMBATE.Basica.usarObjeto.dica: Interacts with an object that takes an action.
COMBATE.Keybind.alternarBarra.Name: Collapse or expand the action bar
COMBATE.Keybind.alternarBarra.Hint: Hides the cards and keeps only the action pips, or opens them again.
COMBATE.Settings.linhaTempo.Name: Initiative timeline
COMBATE.Settings.linhaTempo.Hint: Shows portraits in initiative order at the top of the screen during combat.
COMBATE.Settings.barraAcoes.Name: Action bar
COMBATE.Settings.barraAcoes.Hint: Shows the bar with Action, Bonus Action, Reaction and Movement pips and action cards at the bottom.
COMBATE.Settings.economiaRigida.Name: Strict action economy
COMBATE.Settings.economiaRigida.Hint: Blocks using something whose pip is spent, or Actions/Bonus Actions outside your own turn. When off, pips only warn.
COMBATE.Settings.vidaInimigos.Name: Health of creatures the player doesn't control
COMBATE.Settings.vidaInimigos.Hint: How players see enemy health in the timeline.
COMBATE.Settings.iniciativaInimigos.Name: Show enemy initiative
COMBATE.Settings.iniciativaInimigos.Hint: Players see enemy initiative numbers in the timeline.
COMBATE.Settings.camera.Name: Camera on turn start
COMBATE.Settings.camera.Hint: Who gets the camera panned to the active token.
COMBATE.Settings.marcador.Name: Mesa turn marker
COMBATE.Settings.marcador.Hint: Uses the rune circle as the default image for the native turn marker. Animation and a custom image stay in the Combat Tracker settings.
COMBATE.Settings.resultados.Name: Results screen
COMBATE.Settings.resultados.Hint: When combat ends, shows damage, healing, kills and crits for each character.
COMBATE.Settings.animacoes.Name: Attack animation
COMBATE.Settings.animacoes.Hint: The token lunges at the target, the target shakes or dodges and the result appears on the map.
COMBATE.Settings.anuncio.Name: Turn announcement
COMBATE.Settings.anuncio.Hint: Banner across the screen at combat start, each round and each turn.
COMBATE.Settings.esconderHotbar.Name: Hide the macro bar in combat
COMBATE.Settings.esconderHotbar.Hint: During combat, hides the macro bar and player list for everyone (GM and players) to make room for the action bar.
COMBATE.Settings.imagem.Name: Character image
COMBATE.Settings.imagem.Hint: What shows in the timeline, action bar, turn banner and results. Characters without their own portrait use the token image.
COMBATE.Config.menu.Name: Combate da Mesa settings
COMBATE.Config.menu.Label: Open panel
COMBATE.Config.menu.Hint: Timeline, action bar, rules and scene effects in one panel.
COMBATE.Config.secao.interface.descricao: What shows on screen during combat.
COMBATE.Config.secao.regras.descricao: Action economy and what players see of enemies.
COMBATE.Config.secao.cena.descricao: Animations, banners, camera and the end of combat.
COMBATE.Config.tagMundoDica: Applies to everyone; only the GM can change it.
COMBATE.Config.tagVoceDica: Applies only to this user on this computer.
COMBATE.Config.padraoAviso: Default values filled in. Click Save to apply.
COMBATE.Settings.tema.Name: Theme
COMBATE.Settings.tema.Hint: Light or dark. “Follow Foundry” uses the interface color scheme chosen in Foundry's settings.
COMBATE.Settings.tamanhoBarra.Name: Action bar size
COMBATE.Settings.tamanhoBarra.Hint: Size of the cards and card area in the action bar. Only for you.
COMBATE.Barra.mover: Drag to move the bar. Double-click to send it back to the corner.
COMBATE.Barra.vazioBonus: Nothing on the sheet uses a Bonus Action.
COMBATE.Settings.alvoAoClicar.Name: Target on token click
COMBATE.Settings.alvoAoClicar.Hint: When needed (default): using a card, attack, spell or ability that needs a target with nobody targeted shows a notice, and your next click on a token targets it (Esc cancels). Always: clicking someone else's token always targets it. Shift+click adds targets.
COMBATE.Settings.alvoAoClicar.sempre: Always when clicking someone else's token
COMBATE.Settings.alvoAoClicar.pedir: When the action needs a target
